datasheet_identity.title: DSK32 THRU DSK320 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 matched the expected hash.
DSK38 is the 80 V member of the DSK32 through DSK320 Schottky barrier rectifier family; the datasheet groups DSK38 with DSK310 in Fig. 3 and with DSK36-DSK320 in Fig. 4.
Curve points are digitized from the actual plotted vector curves, not inferred from maximum ratings or interpolated from tabulated limits.
The Fig. 4 reverse-current curve is plotted in microampere and is represented here in amperes; its horizontal axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage, not absolute reverse voltage.
The 0.85 V forward-voltage entry is a maximum bound at 3.0 A and is kept separate from the typical plotted curve points.
extraction.omission_reason: No reverse-recovery specification or breakdown characterization is provided. The 80 V VRRM/VDC ratings are maximum reverse-voltage limits, not breakdown data, so breakdown voltage and breakdown current are omitted.
